title: Figure 8: Fermat's Principle – curved light path from A to B through graded index
description: Diagram on a grey gradient background showing points A and B joined by a dotted straight line and a curved path dipping downward between them. The caption reads "Figure 8. Fermat's Principle. The grey level indicates the refractive index. In traveling from A to B, light follows the path that takes the shortest time, traveling, if possible, through regions of low index." The text relates the figure to mirages and invisibility.
